authority: Explicit user decision: the V1 qualification scope for this execution path is exactly 20 items, an intentional evidence-budget decision.
decision: Supersede the 80-item qualification population (DEC-0056) for the V1 promotion decision on this execution path. The final V1 qualification is a FROZEN 20-item subset drawn deterministically from the original 80-item sealed population. The 20 items were selected and frozen BEFORE any scoring, using only item_id (a content address); gold was never read during selection. The remaining 60 items stay sealed and unused. Governance records truthfully that V1 qualification evidence was reduced from an 80-item population to a frozen 20-item set, and that 20 items are NOT evidentially equivalent to 80. DEC-0056 is preserved as history; it is superseded for scope, not rewritten.

benchmark.note: 3 benchmark prompts are part of the frozen 20; they were used for RUNTIME MEASUREMENT ONLY and were never scored.

inferenceIncident.fix: runtime-only: single-GPU pin (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -> device_map {'': 0}, lm_head cuda:0), Harmony stop-token stopping criteria, torch.inference_mode(). Model, adapter, tokenizer, template, Harmony contract and greedy generation semantics unchanged.
inferenceIncident.observed: first item completed at ~1100.7 s; item 2 still incomplete at ~2010.2 s (>900 s stall)
inferenceIncident.rootCause: (1) no stopping criterion - generate() ran to the full max_new_tokens=3072 ceiling instead of stopping at the Harmony <|return|> terminator; (2) two-GPU sharding placed lm_head on cuda:1, forcing a cross-PCIe transfer per generated token although the model fits on one T4; (3) torch.no_grad() instead of torch.inference_mode().

scopeReduction.evidenceStrengthWarning: A 20-item qualification does NOT carry the statistical strength of an 80-item evaluation. No equivalence may be claimed.
